youtube_description:
Claude Sonnet 5.5 launched September 28. This briefing shows how a project lead can evaluate it on a work presentation, using a public sample brief and a slide template.

The release is new; Claude file creation already existed. Anthropic reports improved document and slide work, but we have not tested those claims live or measured time savings.

Choose Sonnet 5.5 from the model menu when available, check that file creation is enabled, and ask for a downloadable presentation. Use permitted material. Before sharing, compare every figure and conclusion with the source brief and inspect the slides for layout problems. If the draft fails, request a targeted correction and check it again.

Model access, organization controls and plan limits apply. This is a documented evaluation workflow, not a reproduced product demonstration. Follow AI Daily Diff for practical, verified AI developments for work.

File workflow: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12111783-create-and-edit-files-with-claude
